subject: Fix link-time optimization to work correctly for unit tests (i.e. -flto flag) (#1290) (#1296)
reason: The change is build-system only: it adds -ffat-lto-objects to the GCC LTO optimization flags in src/Makefile so unit-test binaries link correctly under -flto=auto. No server code, command behavior, replication, persistence, or reply format changes; there is no runtime path a fuzzer scenario could reach or distinguish between the two builds.
